title: Validation script — build, test, RT-safety, latency checks
description:
Create scripts/validate.sh — the single entry-point release validation script for ChugGate (CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §30–§31).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §30 Testing and §31 Release Criteria
- scripts/build_all.sh and CMakePresets.json for existing build entry points
- CMakeLists.txt ctest / PLUGINVAL / target names (read-only)
- tests/ layout and any existing RT-safety or latency test binaries/names
- Source/PluginProcessor latency reporting paths (read-only; do not edit DSP)

Implement scripts/validate.sh as a bash script that:
1. Builds Release (VST3 + Standalone) via existing CMake presets/scripts; fails non-zero on build failure
2. Runs ctest (or the project’s equivalent test runner) against the Release/test build
3. Runs RT-safety checks: scan or invoke any existing no-alloc / audio-thread safety tests; if no dedicated binary exists, document the grep/check steps that flag new/delete, malloc, locks, or file I/O inside processBlock-related translation units and fail when violations are found in tracked Source paths
4. Zero-latency verification: assert default/disabled lookahead path reports 0 samples latency
5. Lookahead latency verification: for configured lookahead values in range 0–10 ms, assert reported host latency equals the exact sample count for the active sample rate (no hidden latency)
6. Bypass click-free check hook: run or invoke the existing bypass/crossfade unit tests if present; otherwise invoke a named ctest filter or placeholder step that exits non-zero when those tests fail once available
7. State round-trip: invoke state/preset round-trip tests (schema, A/B, noise profile, alignment)
8. Multiband reconstruction flat: invoke multiband unity/reconstruction tests when present

Script requirements:
- set -euo pipefail (or equivalent safe defaults)
- printable section headers and a final PASS/FAIL summary
- exit 0 only when all enforced steps pass; non-zero otherwise
- Prefer calling existing cmake --build / ctest rather than reimplementing build logic
- Do not modify Source/**, CMakeLists.txt, or tests/** in this task
- Make the script executable (chmod +x in the file’s git mode or document #!/usr/bin/env bash)

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/validate.sh exists and begins with a bash shebang
scripts/validate.sh builds Release (VST3 and Standalone) via project CMake/presets and fails on build errors
scripts/validate.sh runs ctest or the project test runner
scripts/validate.sh includes zero-latency (0 samples) verification when lookahead is off
scripts/validate.sh includes lookahead reported-latency checks for configured lookahead values
scripts/validate.sh includes hooks/steps for bypass click-free, state round-trip, and multiband reconstruction flat checks
scripts/validate.sh exits non-zero when any enforced step fails
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify DSP algorithms or PluginProcessor latency computation
require online services or network calls

allowed: call existing cmake presets and ctest from bash
use sectioned steps with clear PASS/FAIL summary
skip gracefully with explicit skip reason only for host-only checks that cannot run in CI, while still enforcing build/test/latency/RT steps that can run headlessly
forbidden: embed host-GUI automation as a hard CI requirement without a skip path
